title: Disable printing info when running spark-sql
question:
I'm running sql commands with spark-sql. I have put rootLogger.level = off in log4j2.properties file, but I'm still getting some info messages:

Spark Web UI available at http://computer:4040
Spark master: local[*], Application Id: local-1745351583376
1
Time taken: 1.559 seconds, Fetched 1 row(s)

How to remove that info from printing, when I run spark-sql -f file.sql
answer:
Simple way to do this spark-sql -f file.sql output.txt 2>&1 it will redirect and keep your sql execution clean...

This doesn’t stop the printing, but it hides it from your terminal.

along with above can also try rootLogger.level = WARN or ERROR
